Client Application:
Browser visiting a
dynamic web app on EC2
— server processes the
request before responding
L7 Application:
[Server processes request, queries DB]
GET /dashboard HTTP/1.1
Host: app.example.com
Cookie: session=xyz
Accept: text/html
Note: EC2 runs server-side
logic — queries DB and
builds response dynamically
L6 Presentation:
[TLS via ACM cert on ALB]
TLS Record {
  Version: TLS 1.3
  SNI: app.example.com
  Certificate: ACM on ALB
  Encrypted Payload: [GET request]
}
L5 Session:
[ALB pins session to EC2 instance]
ALB Sticky Session {
  Target: EC2 i-0abc1234
  Session: server-side
  State: authenticated
  Contrast: no CDN cache —
  every request hits EC2
}
L4 Transport:
[TCP port 443 to ALB]
TCP Segment {
  Source Port: 65100
  Destination Port: 443
  Sequence: 1001
  Acknowledgement: 501
  Flags: ACK
  Data: [TLS record]
}
L3 Network:
[Hits ALB not CDN edge]
IP Packet {
  Source IP: 203.0.113.5
  Destination IP: 54.80.0.1
  Protocol: TCP
  TTL: 64
  Note: hits ALB not CDN edge
  Data: [TCP segment]
}
L2 Data Link:
[Ethernet local delivery]
Ethernet Frame {
  Source MAC: aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:01
  Destination MAC: aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:02
  EtherType: IPv4

}
